name: BOLDÜNGO2 — GUIDED-005 — M1 repère + M2 béton Sud

evidence.observation: M1 height reused only as simplified spatial reference from GUIDED-004; not re-estimated in 005.
Ground-level south door retained unchanged as M2 spatial control; user confirms it is left of the entrance/opening of the covered concrete-terrace space in the described views.
Multi-view reading: a small approximately square landing connects the 7-step lower flight to the turned 9-step upper flight.
The lower flight approaches the house; the upper flight then develops longitudinally along the south side.
Raised masonry platform/terrace with a large covered open void and lower circulation below; explicitly not a solid block. Exact longitudinal extent remains inferred from photos.
FIRST_RUN_7: user confirms 7 steps and 1.12 m width.
Multi-view topology: lower flight runs from the outer south side toward the house to the square landing; its exact run length is inferred.
SECOND_RUN_9: user confirms 9 steps after the intermediate landing.
Absolute orientation correction: this upper flight progresses with increasing scene y, i.e. toward REAR/WEST, along the south facade.
Masonry side parapet follows the lower flight.
Opposite masonry side parapet follows the lower flight.
Outer masonry parapet rises with the upper flight toward the west/rear.
Masonry edge/parapet bounds the high concrete platform while the space beneath remains open.

notes: GUIDED-005 validation scene: M1 is only a simplified spatial reference; M2 concrete south system only. Absolute axes: front=EAST at scene y=0; rear=WEST at increasing scene y; south facade=left at scene x=0 with exterior at negative x. Viewer maps scene (x,y,z) to Three (x,z,y) then applies group.scale.z=-1, so WEST/increasing scene y renders toward negative Three Z. GUIDED-004 mixed these spaces: run 7 increased scene y while run 9 changed x toward the house. Multi-view correction restores the photographed L topology: lower 7-step flight approaches the house, square landing, then upper 9-step flight develops toward WEST/rear with increasing scene y. Stair width 1.12 m and south projection about 2.20 m are USER_CONFIRMED. Unmeasured run lengths, landing placement, platform longitudinal extent and parapet heights are INFERRED from photos and remain provisional. The high concrete platform is a thin elevated slab with open covered void below, never a solid block. M3 timber terrace is deliberately absent; the west edge of the M2 high platform at y=5.31 is reserved only as a future topological connection toward M3.
